mechanism: AF3-selected native mixed quantization: one joint E16 x H16 codeword per token, the curvature weight chosen per prefix by the structural distortion of the resulting hard SIDs

computations.name: mixed cost of a joint codeword
computations.definition: C = 2 * [ alpha * ||rE - eE||^2 + (1 - alpha) * d_c(rH, eH)^2 / 4 ]
computations.gradient: the cost is differentiable in the residuals and in the weight; the discrete assignment is not part of this surface

computations.name: native residual update
computations.definition: rE_next = rE - sg(eE); rH_next = (-sg(eH)) (+) rH, where (+) is the Moebius addition of the canonical contract
computations.gradient: only the chosen code is detached, so the next level's commitment term still reaches the encoder while the codebook of this level is updated by this level's term

computations.name: readout of a complete code
computations.definition: phi(q) = [ sum_l eE_l , log_0(eH_1 (+) (eH_2 (+) eH_3))) ], right-nested because Moebius addition is not associative
computations.gradient: the readout is differentiable in the codewords; the decoder consumes it through the straight-through path z + sg(phi - z)

computations.name: the inner loss
computations.definition: L_base = MSE(D(u_ST), x) + (1/3) * sum_l E_i [ ( C(sg(r_{l-1}), e_{l,k}) + beta * C(r_{l-1}, sg(e_{l,k})) ) / 32 ] with beta = 0.25
computations.output: the loss and the reconstruction term
computations.gradient: the commitment term carries the code's gradient to the residual, the codebook term carries the residual's gradient to the code

computations.name: the AF3 target of a pair
computations.definition: kappa_ij = 4 - d_i - d_j + 3 * T_ij, computed on the training co-occurrence graph only
computations.gradient: none: it is a frozen quantity of the graph

computations.name: the structural distortion
inputs: the readout of the complete hard SIDs
computations.definition: D_AF3 = 0.5 * mean_E Huber_1((mu_ij - kappa_ij)/s_kappa) + 0.5 * mean_{S\E} Huber_1(mu_ij/s_kappa), with mu_ij = p_ij * (2 - sum_k p_ik - sum_k p_jk + 3 sum_k p_ik p_jk), p_ij = sigmoid(b - (1 - cos(phi_i, phi_j))/tau) and p = 0 outside the support
computations.gradient: none: the outer loop reads it, it never backpropagates through it

inputs.embeddings: the frozen stage1 sentence embeddings, one row per item
inputs.graph: the frozen training co-occurrence graph (315,391 edges, 24,556 nodes)
inputs.support: the frozen support S (947,197 pairs), built once with seed 42
inputs.readout: the shared tau and intercept, calibrated once on the F0 snapshot at epoch 1500

outputs.identifiers: the three-token hard SIDs of every item, globally consistent
outputs.alpha_table: the discrete weight of every level and prefix
outputs.readout: phi(q) of every item, used by the outer loop and by the diagnostics

curvature.note: the E arm runs it at zero; nothing learns or scans it

alpha_candidates.note: a bounded symmetric set, not a tuned hyper-parameter

min_prefix_items.note: a prefix below this inherits its nearest ancestor; at the measured SID size the third level has no qualifying prefix, which is reported rather than glossed

min_prefix_probes.note: observed and unobserved supported pairs a prefix needs

outer_loop_seconds.note: the declared wall-clock ceiling of one round; every prefix it defers is recorded by name

gradient_rules: the residual update detaches only the chosen code: rE - sg(eE) and (-sg(eH)) (+) rH
the decoder consumes the readout through the straight-through path z + sg(phi(q) - z)
the commitment term detaches the residual and the codebook term detaches the code
the weight is not an optimizer parameter: it is changed by the discrete outer loop
the assignment rule is the baseline's: argmin, and the balanced Sinkhorn on the last level in training

training_integration.loss: MSE(D(u_ST), x) plus the mean of the three levels' mixed commitment terms
training_integration.optimizer: AdamW, lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, 50 warm-up epochs, gradient clip 1
training_integration.schedule: 3000 epochs, four ranks, per-rank batch 1024, no early stop
training_integration.outer_loop: at epochs 1500, 2000, 2500 and 3000, on rank 0, with the table broadcast to the other ranks

conventions: the canonical Poincare contract owns every hyperbolic operation; the candidate does not re-derive the geometry
the curved half of a codebook is a tangent-space parameter mapped with exp_0 into the ball of curvature c
at c = 0 the canonical distance is 2||u - v||, so d^2/4 is the squared Euclidean distance and the cost of a weight 1/2 is the plain 32-dimensional squared distance
the assignment rule is unchanged: the mechanism supplies the cost matrix only
the graph, the support, the readout and the target never touch the validation or the test split
a new prefix inherits its nearest ancestor, at training and at inference alike

switches.behaviour_off: the weight is fixed at 1/2 for every level and prefix; the outer loop does not run
switches.geometry_off: the curvature is zero, so both halves are Euclidean and the same local outer loop runs
switches.both_on: the full method: the mixed space and the per-prefix outer loop

excluded.surface: the chosen index at any level
the balanced Sinkhorn assignment of the last level
excluded.reason: the baseline's rule; it is not the mechanism's surface

excluded.surface: the straight-through estimator of the decoded vector
excluded.reason: its backward is the identity by construction, not the derivative of its forward value

excluded.surface: the weight itself and the outer loop
excluded.reason: updated from a measured distortion on frozen hard SIDs, never by an optimizer step

excluded.surface: the structural distortion and its Bernoulli surrogate
excluded.reason: a function of discrete identifiers; it is checked against the exact enumeration instead of a gradient

continuous_surface.name: mixed cost of one joint codeword
